text:
Ana: FYI deploybot rejected rc-29 image during preflight. SBOM provenance doesn't match cosign claim. blocking deploy. tagging @Tom for build artifacts

DeployBot: rc-29 blocked by policy 'provenance-check'. Descriptor mismatch: cosign key=B58F... claims digest sha256:deadbeef, registry digest is sha256:feedface. Action: require origin verification or rollback. See: https://ci.internal/provenance/rc-29

Tom: weird, build pipeline uploaded two images in parallel yesterday. pulling logs and verifying. ETA 15m

BuildBot: build/rc-29 completed by Tom at 1761225000. Uploaded image: sha256:feedface. cosign signature uploaded: cosign:sha256:deadbeef. sbom metadata points to feedface.

SRE_Bot: If signatures disagree we can't do a blind rollout. Options: (1) re-sign image with matching digest, (2) rebuild, (3) timebox a canary with extra monitoring + legal/security signoff.

Priya (Security): Security: provenance mismatch forces audit. We're open to a short, tightly controlled canary only if Legal signs off and we include additional runtime attestation (immutable image check) and extended logging. Need artifact provenance in archive.

Nora (Legal): Legal: can't approve global rollout without clear provenance. We can accept a 5% canary limited to non-PII customers for 1 hour for monitoring purposes, provided SBOM + cosign signature + CI log are stored in the evidence bucket and a decision memo is filed.

Tom: Found culprit: old CI worker retried with stale cache leading to different layer order. I can trigger a deterministic rebuild and re-sign. Rebuild ETA ~25m.

Ana: Given change window constraints we prefer to avoid full rollback. Proposed: start a guarded 5% canary in us-east for 1h with immutable-image check (fail if registry digest != cosign claim) and strict rollback thresholds. If canary passes, promote after rebuild and re-sign. Will pause global promotion until signed artifact archived.

DeployBot: Canary proposal requires explicit approvals. Policy: provenance-mismatch -> require security + legal sign-off.

Priya (Security): Approve for timeboxed 5% canary in us-east with attestation and increased logging. Monitor for anomalous runtime behavior and telemetry drift.

Nora (Legal): Approve 5% canary under constraints. Archive links required: SBOM, cosign signature, CI build log, decision memo.
additional_notes: Tom will push deterministic rebuild and BuildBot will cosign. Evidence link to be posted back in thread when available.
